theorems.name: Submission.isoperimetric_apply_eq_zero_of_disjoint_support
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n)) T.support → T ω = 0
